sections.text:
يتكون نظام الاطفاء الذاتى بغاز 
 Co2 من عدد من الاسطوانات يوجد بداخلها غاز ثانى اكسيد 
 الكربون فى حالته السائلة تحت ضغط 80 بار تقريبا كما يتم وضع هذه الاسطوانات فى 
 مجموعات طبقا لكمية الغاز المطلوبة للاطفاء وتكون كل مجموعة من هذه المجموعات 
 مخصصة لاطفاء الحريق فى منطقة محددة تتناسب مع حجم الغاز داخل هذه الاسطوانات 
 ويوجد رشاشات لغاز الاطفاء ومكثفات لهب موزعة كما بالجدول التالى:-

وكل من مكتشف اللهب 
والحرارة لها خطين غير معتمدين على بعضهما ولكى يعمل نظام الحريق لا بد ان تاتى 
اشارة انذار بوجود حريق من احد مكتشفات الحريق على الخط الاول 
مقترنة بانذار على 
احد مكتشفات الحريق على الخط الثانى فان سولونيد تحرير الاوزان يتحرق فيعمل نظام 
الحريق وفى نفس الوقت تذهب اشارة الخروج الاضطرارى 
Trip من مفتاح
limit switch الى مختلف مكونات الوحدة لكى تتوقف

ويعتبر جهاز وزن 
الاسطوانة هو المؤشر لحدوث تسرب مادة الاطفاء من اسطوانة ثانى اكسيد الكربون ويتم 
ضبط جهاز مبين التهريب بحيث يعطى اشارة بوجود التهريب عندما يحدث فقد فى محتوى 
الاسطوانة من مادة الاطفاء بحد اقصى 10% من الوزن الاجمالى للاسطوانة حيث يسقط 
الثقل الاسطوانى رقم 1 الى السفل عند حدوث ذلك ويكون هذا هو المؤشر لانخفاض وزن 
الاسطوانة نتيجة حدوث تسريب للغاز بها فيتم تغييرها

تم اعداد 
هذا المستند بواسطة السيد المهندس / يسرى عبد الحليم عبد اللطيف واختبره السيد المهندس / وصفى 
وليم ناشد - كبير مهندسين ادارة السلامة والصحة المهنية 
ووافق عليه السيد المهندس / محمد محمد اللاوندى المدير العام وتمت المراجعة من السيد الكيميائى / احمد السيد ابراهيم 
والسيد المهندس / سليمان زكى سليمان مدير عام ضمان وتأكيد الجودة وتم اعتماده من السيد المهندس / محمد محمد فرج عنان - رئيس قطاع محطة 
توليد كهرباء دمياط 
والسيد 
المهندس/ 
محمد حسين جمعه رئيس قطاع 
ضمان وتأكيد 
الجودة بشركة شرق الدلتا لإنتاج الكهرباء

sections_en.text: The CO2 automatic fire extinguishing system consists of a number of cylinders containing carbon dioxide gas in its liquid state at a pressure of approximately 80 bar. These cylinders are arranged in groups according to the quantity of gas required for extinguishing, and each group is dedicated to extinguishing a fire in a specific area commensurate with the volume of gas inside these cylinders. There are extinguishing gas sprinklers and flame detectors distributed as in the following table:-

Each of the flame and heat detectors has two independent lines, and for the fire system to operate, a fire alarm signal must come from one of the fire detectors on the first line together with an alarm from one of the fire detectors on the second line; then the weight-release solenoid moves and the fire system operates. At the same time, the emergency trip signal goes from the limit switch to the various components of the unit so that they stop.

The cylinder weighing device is the indicator of a leak of the extinguishing agent from the carbon dioxide cylinder, and the leak indicator device is adjusted so that it gives a signal of a leak when the cylinder loses at most 10% of its total weight, where cylindrical weight No. 1 drops down when this happens, and this is the indicator of a drop in the cylinder weight as a result of a gas leak, so it is replaced.

Mohamed Mohamed El-Lawandy, General Manager. It was reviewed by Chemist Ahmed El-Sayed Ibrahim and Eng. Soliman Zaki Soliman, General Manager of Quality Assurance and Quality Control, and approved by Eng. Mohamed Mohamed Farag Anan - Head of the Damietta Power Generation Station Sector - and Eng. Mohamed Hussein Gomaa, Head of the Quality Assurance and Quality Control Sector at the East Delta Electricity Production Company.

Turn cylindrical weight No. 1 counter-clockwise on threaded shaft No. 2 until the cylindrical weight is barely balanced horizontally
Tighten the cylindrical weight clockwise by three turns
Tighten tightening nuts No. 3 and secure the position of the cylindrical weight with fixing wire No. 4

preussag - minimax

Document approval date:
2 July 2008 | Procedure:
Adjusting the cylinder weighing device (leak indicator device)
Next review date: July 2013
Introduction
The CO2 automatic fire extinguishing system consists of a number of cylinders containing carbon dioxide gas in its liquid state at a pressure of approximately 80 bar. These cylinders are arranged in groups according to the quantity of gas required for extinguishing, and each group is dedicated to extinguishing a fire in a specific area commensurate with the volume of gas inside these cylinders. There are extinguishing gas sprinklers and flame detectors distributed as in the following table:-
Flame detector | Heat detector | Sprinklers | Number of cylinders | 
1 | 4 | 4 | 3 | Right combustion chamber
1 | 4 | 4 | 3 | Left combustion chamber
1 | 4 | 8 | 7 | Oil tank
Each of the flame and heat detectors has two independent lines, and for the fire system to operate, a fire alarm signal must come from one of the fire detectors on the first line together with an alarm from one of the fire detectors on the second line; then the weight-release solenoid moves and the fire system operates. At the same time, the emergency trip signal goes from the limit switch to the various components of the unit so that they stop.
The cylinder weighing device is the indicator of a leak of the extinguishing agent from the carbon dioxide cylinder, and the leak indicator device is adjusted so that it gives a signal of a leak when the cylinder loses at most 10% of its total weight, where cylindrical weight No. 1 drops down when this happens, and this is the indicator of a drop in the cylinder weight as a result of a gas leak, so it is replaced.
This document was prepared by Eng. Yousry Abdel Halim Abdel Latif and tested by Eng. Wasfy William Nashed - Senior Engineer, Occupational Safety and Health Department - and approved by Eng. Mohamed Mohamed El-Lawandy, General Manager. It was reviewed by Chemist Ahmed El-Sayed Ibrahim and Eng. Soliman Zaki Soliman, General Manager of Quality Assurance and Quality Control, and approved by Eng. Mohamed Mohamed Farag Anan - Head of the Damietta Power Generation Station Sector - and Eng. Mohamed Hussein Gomaa, Head of the Quality Assurance and Quality Control Sector at the East Delta Electricity Production Company.
Safety precautions
Open the work order from the Occupational Safety and Health Department | 
Wear personal protective equipment | 
Tools, instruments and equipment used
Cylinder hoist | 
Wrench No. 29 - Adjustable wrench - Pliers | 
Procedures to be carried out
Release the cylindrical weight to undo tightening nuts No. 3 | 1.
Turn cylindrical weight No. 1 counter-clockwise on threaded shaft No. 2 until the cylindrical weight is barely balanced horizontally | 2.
Tighten the cylindrical weight clockwise by three turns | 3
Tighten tightening nuts No. 3 and secure the position of the cylindrical weight with fixing wire No. 4 | 4
